note: ADR 0998: dep-router is not read as source (no pin); useLocation() returns getters over a memo. Chrome warns STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at each untracked `.search`, on every route to the read (a plain binding, an array literal and a pattern, a binding assigned later, an object literal's slot, a project function's parameter, an Object.assign copy): each is covered-uncertifiable. The same routes read in a tracked expression, and a project function of the same name, are quiet. ADR 1002: the same value handed to a project component as a prop (read through `props` or a pattern) or put in a context provider and read by a consumer warns the same way and is covered-uncertifiable; the prop read in a tracked expression is quiet.
